The '''Eye of Corell''' was a large [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]] owned by the [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Lassa Nibs]] which traced her family line back for many generations. Her son, [[Boffen Nibs]], stole it due to a wish for excitement and adventure, and planned to use it to fund the beginnings of a criminal career.
